jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Office of Pro Acceleration - Program Management

jobs.title: DFS Operations Manager - Reno, NV
jobs.description:
Operations. People. Problem-Solving. Repeat.

Are you someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves turning chaos into clarity, and enjoys leading teams to win every single day?

As an Operations Manager , you’ll play a critical role in keeping our daily operations running efficiently while supporting our drivers, office teams, and customers. You’ll partner closely with the General Manager and leadership team to ensure service excellence, compliance, and a great employee experience.

- Role requires obtaining a DOT Medical Card

- DFS: Direct from Store (OMs drive to support teams and development)

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Day-to-Day Operations

- Keep a pulse on on-road operations , monitoring routes, exceptions, and service performance throughout the day

- Support driver teams and customer service by troubleshooting issues, managing calls, and resolving delivery exceptions

- Ensure manifests, routing, dispatch, and check-ins are accurate, compliant, and on time

- Partner with the Router to optimize routes while staying within DOT regulations

- Review exceptions (reschedules, refunds, cancellations) and ensure everything is staged, labeled, and ready

People Leadership

- Train, onboard, and support drivers and technicians so everyone understands the “why” behind the process

- Manage driver schedules based on forecasts and hours budgets

- Conduct performance reviews, provide feedback, and collaborate with HR on engagement and accountability

- Help build a culture where employees feel supported, informed, and set up for success

Process & Compliance

- Review payroll for accuracy and resolve discrepancies

- Ensure full compliance with check-in procedures, MARS cases, claims, and documentation

- Investigate freight and Sedgwick claims and drive timely resolution

- Maintain a clean, organized flow of paperwork, rosters, and daily recap reporting

Inventory & Facility Support

- Order office supplies, uniforms, and parts as needed

- Oversee inbound/outbound staging from Home Depot locations for seamless dispatch

Who You’ll Collaborate With

- General Manager & Leadership Team – strategic planning and execution

- Router – daily dispatch and service optimization

- Recruiting & HR – staffing, engagement, development

- Safety, Training & OpEx Teams – continuous improvement and onboarding

What We’re Looking For

- Strong operational leadership experience

- Proven ability to multitask, prioritize, and problem-solve

- Comfortable using data and metrics to drive decisions

- A people-first mindset with a passion for teamwork and accountability

Why Join Us?

Because what you do matters. Every route you optimize, every team member you support, and every customer experience you have plays a role in our success. If you’re ready to lead, influence, and make an impact—we’d love to have you on our team.

The Home Depot’s Summer Internship program offers college students an opportunity to develop leadership skills and gain hands on experience in a corporate environment. During an 11 – week period from May 17 - July 30 , 2027 , interns will be assigned to a functional team such as Supply Chain, Marketing, e-commerce, Technology, Finance, Operations, Merchandising, Pro, Home Services , Human Resources, etc. Interns will learn more about our retail business and our corporate offices while having the opportunity to work on a pre-assigned project that impacts the function they are supporting. Additionally, interns participate in networking and development activities that set them up for success as they build their careers .

W hat makes a Great Intern:

- Action Oriented : Intern takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm

- Manages Ambiguity : Intern effectively navigates and thrives in uncertain situations while using sound judgment to make decisions without having the full picture. Is able to move work forward without all the details

- Collaboration: Intern contributes to the group’s efforts and steps forward to help as needed. Seeks input from others

- Nimble Learning: Intern actively learns through experimentation when tackling new problems , using both successes and failures as learning fodder

- Communication : Intern develops and delivers multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audience

- Customer Focus : Intern builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions

Description of the Major/Subject Area

Looking for students majoring in Business Management, Business Analytics, Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, Management Information Systems, or a related field. Interns will gain skills in teamwork, organization, accountability, and problem-solving among many others. Along with networking and gaining mentorship, interns will spend time working on skills for their career. Interns will learn how to plan and execute concrete goals, communicate their visions effectively, project manage and collaborate with a team on a shared goal.

Analytics Interns should enjoy digging into data, finding insights and making impacts. They should be experienced working with data in databases and excel pivot tables and able to communicate and explain complicated concepts effectively.

Tasks, responsibilities, and key accountabilities:

- Assisting with data quality assurance and data validation

- Using our data sources to build reports

- Finding and using new sources of data for market share analysis, etc.

- Updating existing reports to meet a level of polish and finesse

- Answering ad-hoc data questions for the business

- Adding value by directly solving needs of a wide range of stakeholders

- Digging into our data to find insights or opportunities for our business

- Helping clean up, document and streamline reporting processes to create efficiencies

- Leverage data manipulation, visualization, and advanced analytics platforms to deliver relevant and timely business insights

- Gain exposure to key leaders across various functional areas

- Utilize project management skills to create team solutions and resolve business issues

- Perform special project work related to Lean Six Sigma focused analytics and consulting

- Complete ad-hoc analysis to support business decision making

Preferred Qualifications:

- Proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint and SQL or Tableau

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written

- Interest in working as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team

- Preferred GPA 3.0 or abov e

​

Description of Roles: (Career paths that utilize this skillset full-time)

At The Home Depot, our associates always have room to move up and explore new opportunities. After the Internship, here are some examples of early career opportunities.

- Online Business Analyst

- Brand Advocate Analyst

- Online Merchandising Analyst

- Marketing Analyst

- Category Experience Analyst

- Merchandise Planner Analyst

- Operations Business Analyst

- Space Planning Analyst

Location: Interns will be expected to work in-person at the Atlanta Corporate Office (Store Support Center) five days a week (Monday-Friday). Housing assistance will be provided to eligible interns.

jobs.title: Manager Operations Process (Product Availability & Selling)
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:
This manager role leads a team that provides front line support to stores while delivering on-shelf availability tools and devices that deliver enterprise value and improve the associate and customer experience. This role owns the business strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of in-aisle tools and store devices that directly impact on-shelf availability, selling, and productivity.
Partnering across Store Operations, field leadership, engineering, and technology teams, the role translates store needs into scalable, enterprise solutions. Key Responsibilities:
- Analyze the fundamental components of problems and communicate the correct course of action to the team and the resolution to the field.

They are responsible for maximizing productivity and expenses while working ethically and modeling Home Depot's core values. They accomplish this goal by developing strategies and objectives and leading a team of managers in executing these strategies and objectives. They must ensure that the distribution center is optimally organized to provide excellent customer service to Home Depot Stores and Customers by ensuring all merchandise is delivered on-time and damage free. jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Construction Resources (CR) is a leading building products distributor serving with a portfolio that includes countertops, appliances, lighting, garage doors, fireplaces, flooring, and more. As we expand into the Dallas market, we are seeking a hands-on, results-driven Operations Manager to lead and oversee all local operational functions. This role will be the key driver of execution in the market, ensuring operational excellence, efficiency, and customer satisfaction as CR establishes a best-in-class presence.

Key Responsibilities

· Operational Leadership:

- Direct all aspects of Dallas operations, including warehouse operations, dispatch, fleet management, field service management, and installation performance.

- Manage and support Warehouse, Dispatch, and Installation leadership to ensure seamless cross-functional execution.

· Fabrication Oversight: - Oversee capacity planning, staffing, and production schedule completion to align with customer commitments.

- Partner with the Fabrication Manager to ensure quality, safety, and timely delivery of finished product.

· Warehouse & Logistics:

- Manage inbound and outbound warehouse operations, inventory control, and order accuracy.

- Ensure optimal routing, loading, and scheduling for on-time delivery.

· Fleet Management:

- Oversee all aspects of the Charleston fleet, including box trucks, service vans, and pickups.

- Leverage Samsara for fleet tracking, compliance, safety, and performance optimization.

- Partner with Dispatch leadership to drive efficiency and reduce downtime.

· Field Service & Installation Performance:

- Ensure best-in-class installation standards and jobsite execution, driving high levels of customer satisfaction.

- Implement effective field service management processes and technology to track performance and resolve issues.

· People & Culture: - Recruit, train, and develop the Charleston operations team.

- Foster a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

· Process & Systems:

- Implement and manage operational systems (including SYSPRO ERP, DispatchTrack, and Samsara fleet management).

- Track KPIs, analyze data, and execute process improvements.

Experience

· 7+ years in operations management, preferably in building products distribution, construction services, or related industries.

· Proven ability to build, develop, and lead teams across warehouse, dispatch, fleet, and field service functions

· Familiarity with ERP and logistics systems (SYSPRO, DispatchTrack, and Samsara experience a plus).

· Strong project management skills, detail orientation, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment.

· Demonstrated track record of ensuring high levels of installation quality and customer satisfaction.

Skills and Experience

· Leadership: Ability to motivate, coach, and develop high-performing teams.

· Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.

· Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

· Technical Proficiency: Experience with inventory management, logistics platforms, and process improvement initiatives.

· Customer Focus: Commitment to delivering outstanding service and operational excellence.

· Adaptability: Comfortable managing change and ambiguity in a growth environment.

· Compliance: Knowledge of safety and regulatory standards relevant to operations.

· Execution-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Position Summary

The Project & Schedule Manager is responsible for overseeing assigned installed product categories throughout the project lifecycle, from quote development through project completion and closeout. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned builders and customers while coordinating project scheduling, resource planning, installation readiness, and operational execution.

The Project & Schedule Manager works cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Warehouse, Installation, and Customer teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and consistent with company quality standards. This position is expected to proactively identify risks, improve operational processes, and support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Pre-Sale & Estimating Support

- Ensure timely and accurate preparation of estimates and quotes for assigned product categories.

- Establish and improve service-level expectations related to quote quality and turnaround time.

- Partner with Sales and Operations leadership to support pricing governance, margin objectives, and approval requirements.

- Identify opportunities to improve quoting processes through automation, technology, and workflow enhancements.

- Maintain current knowledge of product offerings, pricing structures, installation requirements, and operational updates.

Project Management

- Serve as the primary project manager and operational contact for assigned builders and customers.

- Manage projects through all phases, including planning, scheduling, execution, installation, and closeout.

- Monitor project timelines and proactively address schedule impacts, resource constraints, and potential risks.

- Coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders to maintain project momentum and customer satisfaction.

- Manage change orders, scope modifications, and project adjustments while ensuring appropriate documentation and accountability.

- Ensure all assigned projects are completed in accordance with company quality and service standards.

- Verify completion of final quality control inspections and closeout documentation.

Job Site Coordination

- Conduct routine job site visits to assess project progress and installation readiness.

- Perform pre-installation inspections to verify measurements, framing dimensions, utility locations, and site conditions.

- Collaborate with Sales and Operations teams to confirm job readiness before scheduling deliveries or installations.

- Identify and resolve site-related issues that could impact project timelines, quality, or customer satisfaction.

Scheduling & Resource Coordination

- Collaborate with Operations leadership to forecast workload, support capacity planning, and balance available resources.

- Schedule deliveries and installations according to project requirements and customer expectations.

- Communicate directly with builders and customers regarding project schedules and readiness requirements.

- Maintain and manage project schedules utilizing Microsoft Outlook and company scheduling systems.

- Ensure work orders and sales orders are properly assigned and dispatched through DispatchTrack or other approved systems.

- Coordinate delivery documentation, picking schedules, and staging requirements with Warehouse and Operations teams.

- Facilitate communication between departments to support efficient project execution.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

- Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency, scheduling effectiveness, and project execution processes.

- Support implementation of operational best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Assist leadership in developing processes and procedures that improve productivity, service levels, and project outcomes.

- Promote accountability, collaboration, and effective communication across departments.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

- Associate degree, bachelor's degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience preferred.

- Minimum 3-5 years of experience in project management, construction coordination, scheduling, operations management, or a related field.

- Experience working in residential construction, building products, installation services, or similar industries preferred.

- Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Strong knowledge of installed product categories, particularly garage doors and fireplaces (gas and wood-burning).

- General understanding of related product categories including cabinetry, appliances, surfaces, glass, and mirror products.

- Advanced project management, scheduling, and organizational skills.

- Ability to read and interpret architectural plans, construction drawings, engineering documents, and specifications.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to effectively manage customer expectations and maintain professional relationships.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, and Teams.

- Experience with DispatchTrack and project management or scheduling software preferred.

Performance Expectations

- Deliver projects on schedule while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

- Maintain accurate project documentation and scheduling records.

- Demonstrate accountability for project outcomes and operational performance.

- Support departmental growth through proactive planning, communication, and collaboration.

- Consistently identify and mitigate risks before they impact project schedules or customer experience.

- Maintain strong cross-functional relationships that improve overall operational efficiency.

- Ensure project closeouts are complete, accurate, and timely.

Physical Requirements

- Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, reach, and climb stairs throughout the workday.

- Ability to travel regularly to job sites and construction locations.

- Ability to safely navigate active construction environments.

- Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally.

- Ability to operate a computer and other standard office equipment for extended periods.

Work Environment

- Combination of office, warehouse, customer site, and active construction job site environments.

- Frequent interaction with customers, contractors, builders, vendors, and internal team members.

- Regular local travel to project sites is required.

jobs.title: Manager, Organizational Development
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:
Partnering with business leaders and HR teams, the Manager, Organizational Development (OD) supports the design and implementation of OD solutions aligned to business strategy. Acting as an internal consultant, this role gathers and analyzes data to address gaps between current and desired organizational states, supports organization design initiatives, and helps manage change impacts and adoption efforts. On large scale initiatives, the manager works closely with OD Senior Manager(s), leading workstreams and bodies of work. The Manager independently leads small to mid-scale OD projects and facilitate post-implementation reviews and benchmarking to drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:
- 30% - Organization Design & Planning - Supports both large scale organizational design initiatives, leading workstreams, as well as leading small to mid-size initiatives. Scope of work includes team alignment, discovery (qualitative and quantitative analysis of structure, work, processes, etc.), stakeholder feedback, and design of future-state organizations. Supports benchmarking efforts by comparing organizational health to industry standards as well as a best-fit approach and recommending improvements.  Drafts supporting materials, including organizational structures/charts, operating/governance models, and process maps.
- 30% - Organizational Analysis & Stakeholder Partnership - Partners with OD Senior Manager(s) to build strong relationships with business leaders and HR Business Partners. Serves internal stakeholders by developing a best fit approach to align evolving business strategies with our organizational structure, leadership, and culture to optimize organizational performance/effectiveness. Conducts analysis to understand the desired future state and success metrics and identifies best-fit OD solutions across structure, process, systems, and people. Designs and sometimes facilitates key events (e.g., workshops) to support leaders in achieving intentional alignment and planning.
- 20% - Change Management & Communications - Conducts change impact assessments and create communication plans and materials to support leadership and associate transitions. Coordinates with partner teams (e.g., learning, communications, compensation, talent acquisition) to ensure smooth implementation.
- 20% - Implementation & Adoption Support - Creates draft materials to support adoption of new structures and ways of working, via change integration support, leading workshops, and coordinating learning. Follows up on project success metrics post-implementation to ensure optimal adoption and partners with the business and HR Business Partners to make adjustments and plans as appropriate.

jobs.title: DFS General Manager - Houston
jobs.description:
Temco Logistics is a leading provider of final-mile delivery services, trusted by top retailers since 1968. With a track record of handling over 6,000 deliveries daily, we ensure customers receive their products on time and in excellent condition. We're excited to partner with Home Depot to provide customers with the "Direct from Store" delivery experience, allowing them to shop online and have their items delivered the next day by Temco Logistics.

We deliver a wide range of products, including concrete, lumber, drywall, fencing, grills, and more — directly to customers' homes, businesses, and job sites.

As a Field General Manager, you will play a critical role in overseeing daily delivery operations across multiple locations. You’ll lead a team of drivers, ensuring top-tier customer service while optimizing operational efficiency. This is a dynamic, hands-on role where you’ll monitor performance, solve challenges, and support our drivers to exceed customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

-
Oversee daily operations: Conduct site visits to evaluate deliveries, ensuring quality service from start to finish.

-
Address customer needs: Manage complaints, delivery inquiries, and escalations, working directly with Home Depot associates to resolve issues within the same day.

-
Support your team: Monitor and motivate technicians to meet performance goals, providing feedback and creating action plans for continuous improvement.

-
Ensure safety & compliance: Enforce dock safety standards, ensure uniform compliance, and uphold fleet maintenance protocols.

-
Fleet & route management: Schedule and optimize technician routes, ensuring timely deliveries. Oversee vehicle inspections and coordinate preventative maintenance.

-
Continuous improvement: Review performance metrics, document service failures, and work with the team to implement improvements.

-
Collaborate cross-functionally: Coordinate with Home Depot stores to ensure smooth operations and align on customer needs.

Required Qualifications:

-
Experience: 3-7 years in Operations, Logistics, or Transportation Management.

-
Skills: Strong leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple locations and teams effectively.

-
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or related field preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.

-
Tech-Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and route management software.
